purpose: Andrea presents the QR code linking directly to the EduForum deck on GitHub Pages.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: square transparent cutout illustration for the existing EduForum educational presentation, replacing the Andrea laptop illustration on a practice slide.
Input images: Image 1 is the character identity and illustration style reference; Image 2 is the exact functional QR artwork to reproduce on the sign.
Primary request: Andrea, recognisably the same young adult with thick curly chestnut-brown hair, brown eyes, warm light skin, teal zip hoodie and off-white T-shirt, faces the viewer with a friendly small smile, holding up a large square white placard with the black-and-white QR from image 2.
Style/medium: match image 1 closely, refined dark ink contours, detailed sculpted hair strands, polished graphic-novel/anime-influenced rendering, natural anatomy, warm skin shading, layered cel shading and fabric folds.
Composition/framing: centered waist-up character, all hair and both hands inside the canvas, compact square composition with modest transparent margins. Andrea's face and hair occupy the upper portion; the large square white QR placard occupies the lower central portion. Hold its side edges with both hands so fingers do not cover the code. The placard faces the viewer perfectly straight, with horizontal/vertical sides and NO perspective distortion. QR square large and central, preserving every black module of image 2 and its clean white quiet zone exactly, crisp and flat, no texture, no reflections, no shadows across the code. Make the square code around 45 percent of the image width so it remains scannable on a slide.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, no color field or checkerboard baked in.
Constraints: preserve Andrea's identity and clothing; reproduce the supplied QR accurately as a composited functional graphic, not an invented QR-like pattern. QR encodes https://cremarco.github.io/AIandLearning/eduforum/. No laptop, textbook, extra people, text, logos, watermark or decorative elements. Opaque character and white placard; transparent empty background.
